summary: A reading of Venusian Health Magic, a mid-century UFO contactee book in which Los Angeles mystic Michael X. Barton claims Venusian masters sent him telepathic health advice, chiefly fasting and an all raw-fruit diet, alongside the Valiant Thor legend of early American ufology.

evidence.note: Valiant Thor introduced as the founding figure of the Venusian contactee scene; long segment follows
Thor lore: claimed 1957 landing in Virginia and 1958 appearance at a UFO convention
Beckley introduced as publisher and intro writer; obituary details and 2021 death
author and friend form a contact group in Washington State in 1953
the book's core narrative starts in 1955 with the friend's illness and LA visit
reader letter recalls a Barton lecture in San Antonio around 1965
the four vital essentials and raw-food rules presented as disease prevention
cleansing fast prescription from the Venusian healer
host argues UFO subculture was later absorbed by QAnon; ties to present
